title: One line, two calls
prompt: Using exactly ONE `Console.Write` and ONE `Console.WriteLine` (in that order), make `program()` print `A B` on a single line. `Write` prints `A `, `WriteLine` prints `B`.

tests.name: single-line
tests.code:
string outText = Cj.Capture(() => Solution.program());
Cj.Eq(outText, "A B\n", "output");
tests.hint: Write does not end the line; WriteLine does.
